correctness.rationale: The cutoff identity and low-tail Kolmogorov estimate are taken with their exact constants from Hung. For even \(q=2r\) with \(r\le k\), Hung’s squared-polynomial design estimate applied to \(p(t)=t^r\) gives the required relative \(q\)-th moment bound. The beta moment is exact, the inequality \(\ln z\le z^{q-1}/(e(q-1))\) is globally sharp for \(z\ge1\), and one-variable minimization yields the displayed constant. The case \(\eta=0\) and the cutoff boundary cases are handled separately. The asymptotic \(n^2(\ln n)^2\) corollary follows by substituting the source marginal rate in the regime \(k\ll2^n\). The finite verifier checks algebraic reductions but is not used as an infinite proof.
